cards.example_en: The food was absolutely delicious.
cards.example_zh: 食物绝对美味。

cards.example_en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
cards.example_zh: 植物吸收空气中的二氧化碳。

cards.example_en: Love is an abstract idea.
cards.example_zh: 爱情是一个抽象的概念。

cards.example_en: No one should shout abuse at a player after a match.
cards.example_zh: 比赛结束以后，谁都不该冲着球员大骂。

cards.example_en: She has an excellent academic record.
cards.example_zh: 她有着优秀的学术成绩。

cards.example_en: She put the accent on the wrong syllable and we laughed.
cards.example_zh: 她把重音放错了音节，惹得我们笑了起来。

cards.example_en: Students have free access to the library.
cards.example_zh: 学生可以免费使用图书馆。

cards.example_en: The price includes travel and accommodation.
cards.example_zh: 价格包括旅费和住宿费。

cards.example_en: Parents should accompany young children.
cards.example_zh: 家长应当陪同年幼的孩子。

cards.example_en: The report gives an accurate picture of the problem.
cards.example_zh: 该报告准确地描述了问题。

cards.example_en: Don't accuse your classmate without any real proof.
cards.example_zh: 没有真凭实据，就不要指责你的同学。

cards.example_en: Passing the exam was a great achievement.
cards.example_zh: 通过考试是一项了不起的成就。

cards.example_en: The lab teacher warned us not to touch the acid.
cards.example_zh: 实验老师提醒我们不要碰那种酸。

cards.example_en: He should acknowledge his mistake to the teacher today.
cards.example_zh: 他今天应该向老师承认自己的错误。

cards.example_en: Children acquire language very quickly.
cards.example_zh: 儿童很快就学会了语言。

cards.example_en: It took him a while to adapt to college life.
cards.example_zh: 他花了一段时间才适应大学生活。

cards.example_en: The film is an adaptation of a famous novel.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影改编自一部名著。

cards.example_en: The article describes a phone addict who cannot stop scrolling.
cards.example_zh: 文章写了一个停不下来刷手机的人。

cards.example_en: Addition is easier for me than long division.
cards.example_zh: 对我来说，加法比长除法容易。

cards.example_en: You can adjust the height of the chair.
cards.example_zh: 你可以调节椅子的高度。

cards.example_en: The school administration moved the exam to Monday.
cards.example_zh: 学校行政部门把考试改到了星期一。

cards.example_en: You should admit breaking the window to your parents.
cards.example_zh: 你应该向父母承认，窗户是你打破的。

cards.example_en: The school will adopt a new timetable next term.
cards.example_zh: 学校下学期将采用一份新的时间表。

cards.example_en: Everyone smiled at the adorable baby in the red hat.
cards.example_zh: 大家看见戴红帽子的可爱宝宝都笑了。

cards.example_en: Runners advance toward the finish when the whistle blows.
cards.example_zh: 哨声一响，赛跑的人就向终点前进。

cards.example_en: Travelling alone was a real adventure.
cards.example_zh: 独自旅行是一次真正的冒险。

cards.example_en: Shops advertise summer clothes in the window this week.
cards.example_zh: 各家商店本周在橱窗里为夏装做广告。

cards.example_en: I saw an advertisement for a new phone.
cards.example_zh: 我看到一个新手机的广告。

cards.example_en: Doctors advocate sleeping at least eight hours.
cards.example_zh: 医生提倡至少睡八小时。

cards.example_en: The missing wallet became a family affair that evening.
cards.example_zh: 那天晚上，钱包丢了成了全家人的事。

cards.example_en: Loud noise can affect your hearing at the concert.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会上的巨大噪声会影响你的听力。

cards.example_en: We had lunch afterward.
cards.example_zh: 我们之后吃了午饭。

cards.example_en: The travel agency booked our train tickets yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 旅行社昨天把我们的火车票订好了。

cards.example_en: Sports day is the first item on the school agenda.
cards.example_zh: 运动会是学校议程上的第一项。

cards.example_en: Both teams signed an agreement before the friendly match.
cards.example_zh: 两支队伍在友谊赛开始前签了一份协议。

cards.example_en: Our village depends on agriculture and the summer rain.
cards.example_zh: 我们村靠农业和夏天的雨水过日子。

cards.example_en: Which airline are we taking for the family holiday?
cards.example_zh: 这次全家出去度假，我们坐哪家航空公司？

cards.example_en: The nurse cleaned my cut with alcohol at the clinic.
cards.example_zh: 护士在诊所里用酒精给我洗了伤口。

cards.example_en: My little brother walked alongside Dad across the market.
cards.example_zh: 弟弟走在爸爸旁边，一起穿过了市场。

cards.example_en: Is there an alternative to this plan?
cards.example_zh: 此计划是否有其他替代方案？

cards.example_en: The bill was twenty yuan altogether.
cards.example_zh: 账单一共二十元。

cards.example_en: He is an amateur photographer, not a professional.
cards.example_zh: 他是业余摄影师，不是职业的。

cards.example_en: Her ambition is to become a doctor after university.
cards.example_zh: 她的抱负是大学毕业以后当医生。

cards.example_en: The ambitious student aims for the top score in physics.
cards.example_zh: 那个有野心的学生想拿下物理最高分。

cards.example_en: An ambulance reached the playground within ten minutes.
cards.example_zh: 救护车不到十分钟就赶到了操场。

cards.example_en: A large amount of money was stolen.
cards.example_zh: 一大笔钱被偷了。

cards.example_en: The clown's tricks amuse the children.
cards.example_zh: 小丑的把戏把孩子们逗乐了。

cards.example_en: Scientists analyse the river water after heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 大雨过后，科学家会分析河水。

cards.example_en: My ancestor came from a small village.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖先来自一个小村庄。

cards.example_en: His anger cooled after he talked with his father.
cards.example_zh: 他和父亲谈过以后，怒气就慢慢消了。

word.example_en: Students need access to the library.
word.example_zh: 学生需要接触图书馆的机会。

word.example_en: They accuse him of copying the essay.
New students soon adapt to the timetable.
In addition to English, she studies physics.
word.example_zh: 除英语之外，她还学物理。

word.example_en: Please buy the ticket in advance.
Her ambition for medicine started early.
word.example_zh: 她对医学的抱负开始得很早。

word.example_en: The fees amount to two hundred yuan.
Anger at the delay filled the room.
word.example_zh: 对延误的怒气充满了房间。
